title: Random-effects meta-regression in the browser: validation against the R package metafor
description: v1.1.0 release-run evidence dated 2026-10-21 on allmeta v1.8.0 1cb3f8409c7af75ed41f7e1811f9c502f900fc79. Original PM one-moderator validation: 1742/1742 browser configurations identical; 129867/129903 non-LS checks, 36 documented differences and 0 unexpected. PR #149 multiple-moderator ML, likelihood-ratio tests, AIC/BIC and bubble confidence bands: 52573/52573 numerical checks and 52767/52767 browser-panel checks (overlapping totals). Original UI 4/4; safeguards 51/51. Experimental LS remains separate: historical 82680/91515, fresh R 88194/95203. See the preserved release log and RECUT_NOTES.md.
